name: B2 — Upper Intermediate
description: Discuss abstract topics, defend opinions, and handle the news, the workplace, and contemporary Chinese culture.

topics.title: Expressing opinions
topics.description: Hedge, agree, push back, and stack reasons

guide.intro: At B2 you stop just stating opinions and start structuring them — adding nuance, layering reasons, and naming the side you fall on. Three patterns will carry most of your opinion-talk for the rest of your Chinese life: 不僅…而且 (not only…but also), 我覺得…比較 (I think…relatively), and 一方面…另一方面 (on one hand…on the other).

sections.text: 不僅…而且 — not only…but also

不僅 (bù jǐn) sets up the first half of a two-part claim, and 而且 (ér qiě) adds the second, usually stronger, point. The two halves can share a subject (which sits in front) or have different subjects (which sit after each particle).

rows.source: 他不僅會說中文，而且會說日語。
rows.pinyin: Tā bù jǐn huì shuō Zhōngwén, ér qiě huì shuō Rìyǔ.
rows.translation: He not only speaks Chinese, but also Japanese.

rows.source: 這家餐廳不僅便宜，而且很好吃。
rows.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bù jǐn piányi, ér qiě hěn hǎo chī.
rows.translation: This restaurant is not only cheap but also delicious.

rows.source: 不僅我喜歡他，而且我妹妹也喜歡他。
rows.pinyin: Bù jǐn wǒ xǐhuan tā, ér qiě wǒ mèimei yě xǐhuan tā.
rows.translation: Not only do I like him, but my sister does too.

sections.text: Common mistake: dropping 而且 and joining with a comma. In Mandarin, 不僅 always pairs with 而且 (or 也 / 還). "他不僅高，帥" sounds incomplete.
Softening: 我覺得 + 比較

比較 (bǐ jiào) means "relatively" or "fairly" — it takes the edge off an opinion the way "kind of" does in English. Pair it with 我覺得 (wǒ jué de, "I feel") for a polite, hedged tone that won't sound confrontational.

rows.source: 我覺得這個想法比較有意思。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zhè ge xiǎngfǎ bǐ jiào yǒu yì si.
rows.translation: I think this idea is fairly interesting.

rows.source: 我覺得他說的比較有道理。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ jué de tā shuō de bǐ jiào yǒu dào lǐ.
rows.translation: I think what he said makes a fair amount of sense.

sections.text: Two sides: 一方面…另一方面
Use 一方面 (yī fāng miàn)…另一方面 (lìng yī fāng miàn) to lay out two sides of the same issue — the closest Mandarin gets to "on one hand…on the other hand".

rows.source: 一方面工作很累，另一方面工資也不高。
rows.pinyin: Yī fāng miàn gōng zuò hěn lèi, lìng yī fāng miàn gōng zī yě bù gāo.
rows.translation: On one hand the work is tiring, on the other hand the pay isn't great either.

我不太同意 — I don't quite agree

lessons.title: I think, I feel
lessons.description: Stating a view with 覺得 and 認為

exercises.prompt: What's the difference between 覺得 and 認為?
options: 覺得 is more casual/feeling-based; 認為 is more considered/formal
覺得 means "think"; 認為 means "feel"
exercises.answer: 覺得 is more casual/feeling-based; 認為 is more considered/formal

exercises.prompt: Build "I think this movie is really worth watching"
exercises.answer: 我 覺得 這部 電影 很 值得 看
I think what he said makes sense
acceptableAnswers: I believe what he said makes sense
I think he has a point

exercises.prompt: Which is the most natural way to soften "I think it's expensive"?
exercises.answer: 我覺得有點兒貴
exercises.explanation: 有點兒 (yǒu diǎnr) before an adjective is what does the softening — without it, 我覺得貴 is grammatical but blunt.

exercises.prompt: Build a more formal opinion: "I personally believe this idea is worth considering"
exercises.answer: 我 個人 認為 這個 想法 值得 考慮
exercises.explanation: 我個人認為 (wǒ gè rén rèn wéi) lifts the register — 個人 ("personally") plus 認為 sounds essay-like; 我覺得 would be the casual swap.

exercises.prompt: A friend asks 你覺得這家餐廳怎麼樣? Which reply HEDGES the most?
exercises.answer: 還行吧，菜比較一般
exercises.explanation: 還行吧 ("it's okay, I guess") plus 比較一般 ("relatively average") is the classic Chinese hedge — neither praising nor trashing.

exercises.source: 在我看來，這件事沒那麼簡單
exercises.answer: In my view, this matter isn't that simple
acceptableAnswers: From my perspective, it's not that simple
The way I see it, this isn't so simple
In my opinion, this isn't that simple
exercises.explanation: 在我看來 (zài wǒ kàn lái) — "in my view". A common B2 opener for stating an opinion with a touch more weight than 我覺得.

exercises.prompt: the opinion-opener to its register

pairs.right: Stating a view: in my view
Older / literary: as I see it

exercises.prompt: Build "I think this question deserves more thought"
exercises.answer: 我 覺得 這個 問題 值得 多 想 一下

exercises.prompt: Pick the BLUNT version (avoid in polite settings):
options: 我覺得他說得有點兒不對
exercises.answer: 他說的不對
exercises.explanation: Bare 不對 with no hedge is direct to the point of rude. The other three all soften with 覺得, 不太, or 可能.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "我覺得對" into a more formal/considered opinion. The blank should fill in: "我 ___ 這個觀點是正確的"
exercises.answer: 認為
exercises.explanation: Swap 覺得 → 認為 to lift register. 我認為這個觀點是正確的 — "I believe this view is correct".

exercises.prompt: Tap the opener you hear
exercises.spokenText: 在 我 看 來
options: 在 我 看 來
在 我 來 看
看 來 我 在
我 看 在 來
exercises.answer: 在 我 看 來
exercises.explanation: 在我看來 (zài wǒ kàn lái) is a fixed four-syllable opener — the order is locked.

exercises.prompt: Yesterday I read this article. Pick the natural Mandarin order — time word placement:
exercises.answer: 昨天我看了這篇文章。
exercises.explanation: In Chinese, time words go before the verb — usually at the start of the clause or right after the subject. "我看了這篇文章昨天" (English order) is wrong.

exercises.prompt: English: "Because the movie was long, so I left." In Chinese, picking BOTH 因為 and 所以 is fine. But which natural rendering matches B2 register?
options: 因為電影太長了，所以我就走了。
因為電影太長了，我就走了所以。
我走了所以因為電影太長。
電影太長所以因為我走了。
exercises.answer: 因為電影太長了，所以我就走了。
exercises.explanation: Unlike English, where doubling "because…so" sounds redundant, Chinese commonly uses both 因為…所以…together. Just keep them at the start of each clause.

exercises.source: 我個人認為這個想法值得考慮
exercises.answer: Personally I believe this idea is worth considering
acceptableAnswers: I personally believe this idea deserves consideration
In my personal view this idea is worth thinking about
exercises.explanation: 我個人認為 lifts the register from casual 我覺得 — common in essays and meetings.

exercises.prompt: Build "In my view, this view is not entirely correct"
exercises.answer: 在 我 看 來 這 個 看法 不 完全 正確

exercises.prompt: Pick the most hedged way to say "I think it's a bit expensive":
exercises.answer: 我覺得有點兒貴
exercises.explanation: 有點兒 + adj is the classic hedge. The other options are blunt/casual.

exercises.prompt: Lift the register: casual 我覺得 → formal/considered "我 ___ 這個想法很好"
exercises.answer: 認為
exercises.explanation: 認為 is the considered/formal cousin of 覺得.

exercises.source: 我覺得他說的比較有道理
exercises.answer: I think what he said makes fairly good sense
acceptableAnswers: I feel he has a fairly reasonable point
I think what he says is fairly reasonable

exercises.prompt: Tap the opener you hear
exercises.spokenText: 我 個 人 認 為
options: 我 個 人 認 為
我 個 人 覺 得
我 在 看 來
依 我 之 見
exercises.answer: 我 個 人 認 為
exercises.explanation: 我個人認為 — five syllables, formal opener. Listen for the 4-tone 認 and 2-tone 為.

lessons.title: Not only, but also
lessons.description: Stack reasons with 不僅…而且

exercises.prompt: Build "This restaurant is not only cheap but also delicious"
exercises.answer: 這家 餐廳 不僅 便宜 而且 很 好吃

exercises.prompt: Pick the best translation for "Not only do I like him, my sister also likes him":
options: 不僅我喜歡他，而且我妹妹也喜歡他
exercises.answer: 不僅我喜歡他，而且我妹妹也喜歡他

exercises.source: 他不僅聰明，而且很努力
exercises.answer: He is not only smart but also hardworking
acceptableAnswers: Not only is he smart, he is also hardworking
He's not only clever but also diligent

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.answer: 他不僅高，帥
exercises.explanation: 不僅 must pair with 而且 / 還 / 也. A bare comma is not enough — the second clause needs a connector.

exercises.prompt: 不僅 cannot pair with which of these?
exercises.answer: 但是
exercises.explanation: 但是 introduces contrast ("but"). 不僅 needs an additive partner: 而且, 還, or 也.

exercises.prompt: Convert single-clause to compound: "He's hardworking and talented" → use 不僅...而且
exercises.answer: 他 不僅 努力 而且 有 才華

exercises.prompt: "這部電影不僅好看，___ 很有意義"
exercises.answer: 而且
exercises.explanation: Any of 而且 / 還 / 也 completes the 不僅 pattern. The most common written choice is 而且.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phone is not only expensive but also doesn't have a good battery"
exercises.answer: 這 部 手機 不僅 貴 而且 電池 也 不 好

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "Not only does she sing, she also dances":
options: 她不僅會唱歌，還會跳舞
exercises.answer: 她不僅會唱歌，還會跳舞

exercises.source: 內卷不僅影響年輕人，還影響整個社會
exercises.answer: Involution doesn't only affect young people, it also affects the whole society
acceptableAnswers: Involution affects not only young people but the whole society
Not only does involution affect young people, it affects all of society
exercises.explanation: 內卷 — the cutthroat competition meme. The 不僅...還 frame stacks two scopes of impact.

exercises.prompt: Tap the connector you hear
exercises.answer: 不 僅
exercises.explanation: 不僅 (bù jǐn) and 不但 (bù dàn) are near-synonyms — 不但 is slightly more spoken. 不過 means "however" and 不然 means "otherwise". Listen for the second syllable.

exercises.prompt: Build "He's not only smart, but also very hardworking"
exercises.answer: 他 不僅 聰明 而且 非常 努力

exercises.prompt: 不僅 cannot pair with:
exercises.answer: 可是
exercises.explanation: 可是 introduces contrast. 不僅 needs an additive: 而且 / 還 / 也.

exercises.source: 他不僅會說中文，還會說日語
exercises.answer: He not only speaks Chinese, but also Japanese
acceptableAnswers: Not only does he speak Chinese, he speaks Japanese too
He can speak Chinese as well as Japanese

exercises.prompt: "這家餐廳 ___ 便宜，___ 很好吃"
exercises.answer: 不僅 / 而且
exercises.explanation: Classic 不僅...而且 frame for stacking two positive points.

exercises.prompt: Build "Not only do I like him, but my sister also likes him"
exercises.answer: 不僅 我 喜歡 他 而且 我 妹妹 也 喜歡 他

exercises.prompt: Best translation: "This restaurant is not only cheap but also delicious":
options: 這家餐廳不僅便宜而且很好吃
exercises.answer: 這家餐廳不僅便宜而且很好吃
He is not only tall but also very handsome
acceptableAnswers: Not only is he tall, he is also very handsome
He's tall and also very good-looking

exercises.prompt: Build "Involution not only affects work, but also affects life"
exercises.answer: 內卷 不僅 影響 工作 還 影響 生活

exercises.prompt: Tap the second-half connector you hear
exercises.answer: 而 且
exercises.explanation: 而且 (ér qiě) is the standard partner of 不僅. Don't confuse with 但是 (contrast).

lessons.title: Agree & disagree
lessons.description: 同意, 反對, and the polite middle

exercises.prompt: the phrase to its meaning
Which is the most polite way to disagree?
exercises.answer: 我有不同的看法
exercises.explanation: Literally "I have a different view" — softer than a direct "you're wrong".

exercises.prompt: Build "I basically agree with your point of view"
exercises.answer: 我 基本 同意 你 的 看法

exercises.prompt: the agreement to its strength

pairs.right: Soft: I feel that way too

exercises.prompt: the disagreement to its tone

pairs.right: Pushback: I wouldn't put it that way

exercises.prompt: Build a hedged disagreement: "I'm not entirely sure I agree with this view"
exercises.answer: 我 不 太 確定 我 同意 這 個 看法

exercises.prompt: Your boss states a view in a meeting. Which response is appropriate?
options: 您的看法很有道理，不過我有一點不同意見
exercises.answer: 您的看法很有道理，不過我有一點不同意見
exercises.explanation: Concede first (有道理), then introduce disagreement with 不過 ("however") and a softener like 一點 — the standard formula for pushback in formal settings.

exercises.answer: That's true, but…
exercises.explanation: 話是這麼說，可是… is the most common spoken way to concede a point and pivot to your real objection.

exercises.prompt: Pick the strongest agreement:
exercises.answer: 完全同意

exercises.prompt: Build a hedge: "To some extent, I agree with you"
exercises.answer: 在 某 種 程度 上 我 同意 你
exercises.explanation: 在某種程度上 — "to a certain degree" — the classic essay hedge before partial agreement.

exercises.prompt: Tap the phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 我 不 太 同意
options: 我 不 太 同意
exercises.answer: 我 不 太 同意
exercises.explanation: 不太 + verb is the soft-disagreement frame. Hear it as a polite "not quite" rather than "not at all".

exercises.prompt: Build "I completely agree with your view"
exercises.answer: 我 完全 同意 你 的 看法

exercises.prompt: Pick the polite pushback for use with a boss:
options: 您說得有道理，不過我有一點不同看法
exercises.answer: 您說得有道理，不過我有一點不同看法
exercises.explanation: Concede first (有道理), then introduce disagreement softly (一點不同看法).

exercises.answer: I basically agree with your view
acceptableAnswers: I largely agree with your view
I mostly agree with what you think

exercises.prompt: Soft pushback: "我 ___ 同意你的看法" (I don't quite agree)
exercises.answer: 不太
exercises.explanation: 不太 + verb is the soft-disagreement frame: "not quite agree" instead of "disagree".

exercises.prompt: Build "To some extent, what you said makes sense"
exercises.answer: 在 某 種 程度 上 你 說 得 有 道理

exercises.prompt: Which phrase is the strongest disagreement?
exercises.answer: 完全反對
exercises.explanation: 完全反對 = completely opposed. The others are all softened/polite forms.

exercises.answer: I wouldn't put it that way
acceptableAnswers: You can't say it like that
That's not quite how I'd put it
exercises.context: huà bù néng zhè me shuō

exercises.prompt: Build "That's indeed the case, but…"
exercises.answer: 確實 如此 但是

exercises.prompt: Tap the strong-agreement phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 完 全 同 意
options: 完 全 同 意
基 本 同 意
不 太 同 意
完 全 反 對
exercises.answer: 完 全 同 意
exercises.explanation: 完全同意 — "completely agree". The strongest form on the agreement spectrum.

lessons.title: Two sides of an issue
lessons.description: 一方面…另一方面 and 既…又

exercises.prompt: What does "一方面…另一方面" mean?
options: On one hand… on the other hand
exercises.answer: On one hand… on the other hand

exercises.prompt: Build "On one hand the work is tiring, on the other hand the pay isn't high"
exercises.answer: 一方面 工作 很 累 另一方面 工資 也 不 高
She is both smart and beautiful
acceptableAnswers: She is smart as well as beautiful
exercises.explanation: 既…又 (jì…yòu) stacks two qualities of the same subject — "both…and".

exercises.prompt: Which best translates "It's expensive but worth it"?
exercises.answer: 貴但是值得

exercises.prompt: Build "On one hand the salary is high, on the other hand the pressure is also great"
exercises.answer: 一方面 工資 很 高 另一方面 壓力 也 很 大

exercises.source: 這個工作既穩定又有意思
exercises.answer: This job is both stable and interesting
acceptableAnswers: This job is stable and also interesting
It's a job that is both steady and interesting
exercises.explanation: 既...又 — stacks two qualities of one subject. 既 X 又 Y means "both X and Y".

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.answer: 她既漂亮也聰明
exercises.explanation: 既 pairs with 又 (not 也). 既 X 又 Y is the locked frame.

exercises.prompt: Build "Studying abroad has both advantages and disadvantages"
exercises.answer: 出國 留學 既 有 好處 又 有 壞處

exercises.prompt: the two-sided pattern

pairs.right: On one hand…on the other (separate clauses)

exercises.answer: Everything has two sides
acceptableAnswers: There are two sides to everything
exercises.context: fán shì dōu yǒu liǎng miàn
exercises.explanation: A common B2 set phrase to open a balanced opinion. 凡事 = every matter.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although AI is convenient, it also brings problems"
exercises.answer: 雖然 人工智慧 很 方便 但是 也 帶 來 一些 問題

exercises.prompt: Pick the most balanced essay-style opening:
options: 凡事都有兩面：一方面…另一方面…
exercises.answer: 凡事都有兩面：一方面…另一方面…
exercises.explanation: Balanced essays in Chinese almost always open with 凡事都有兩面 or a similar two-sides formula before laying out 一方面 / 另一方面.

exercises.source: 一方面工作很累，另一方面工資也不高
exercises.answer: On one hand the work is tiring, on the other hand the pay isn't high either
acceptableAnswers: On one hand work is exhausting; on the other, the pay is also not high
The work is tiring, and the pay isn't great either

exercises.prompt: Build "This restaurant is both cheap and delicious" (既...又)
exercises.answer: 這家 餐廳 既 便宜 又 好吃

exercises.prompt: 既 must pair with which word?
exercises.answer: 又
exercises.explanation: 既 X 又 Y is locked. 也 pairs with 不僅, not 既.

exercises.prompt: "一方面 工資 很 高 ___ 壓力 也 很 大"
exercises.answer: 另一方面
exercises.explanation: 一方面 must pair with 另一方面 — the locked two-sides frame.

exercises.answer: She is both pretty and smart
acceptableAnswers: She is both beautiful and clever
She's pretty as well as smart

exercises.prompt: Build "Everything has two sides — one hand the advantages, on the other the disadvantages"
exercises.answer: 凡事 都 有 兩 面 一方面 好處 另一方面 壞處

exercises.prompt: Pick the GRAMMATICALLY CORRECT sentence:
options: 這個工作既穩定又有意思
這個工作既穩定也有意思
一方面工作很累也另一方面工資不高
exercises.answer: 這個工作既穩定又有意思
exercises.explanation: 既 must pair with 又, not 也 / 但是. 一方面 must pair with 另一方面.

exercises.prompt: Tap the two-sided opener you hear
options: 另 一 方 面
凡 事 兩 面
一 方 二 面
exercises.answer: 一 方 面
exercises.explanation: 一方面 (yī fāng miàn) — "on one hand". Three syllables, falling-rising-falling cadence.

exercises.prompt: Soften: "劇情___拖沓" (somewhat draggy)
exercises.answer: 比較

exercises.answer: the acting isn't bad

I'd recommend it, though you'll need patience

exercises.prompt: The phrase 反而 signals:

exercises.prompt: Theme runs through the film: "那種感覺確實___全片"
exercises.answer: 貫穿

覺 得 我 大 概

exercises.prompt: Build: "Recommended, but you need patience"

推薦看因此節奏比較慢

exercises.explanation: 不過 introduces a soft caveat — the natural "but" for hedged recommendations.

the topic the director wanted to express

exercises.prompt: Recommend with caveat: "推薦看，___得有耐心"
exercises.answer: 不過

exercises.prompt: 疏離感 most accurately means:
exercises.answer: a sense of alienation

exercises.prompt: Build: "I partly agree, but the slow pace actually has flavor"

topics.title: News & current events
topics.description: Read a headline, summarize what happened, give your take

lessons.title: News vocabulary
lessons.description: 新聞, 報道, 媒體 — the building blocks

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
What does "頭條新聞" (tóu tiáo xīn wén) mean?
exercises.answer: Headline news
exercises.explanation: 頭條 literally means "top entry" — but it's also the name of a hugely popular news app, 今日頭條.

exercises.answer: According to reports

exercises.prompt: the news-vocabulary term
What does "自媒體" (zì méi tǐ) mean?
exercises.answer: Self-published online media / influencer-style media
exercises.explanation: 自媒體 — literally "self-media". The Weibo / WeChat public accounts ecosystem; contrasted with 傳統媒體 (traditional media).

exercises.prompt: online vs traditional media term
Build "This piece of news got onto the trending list (熱搜)"
exercises.answer: 這 條 新聞 上 了 熱搜
Exclusive report / exclusive coverage

exercises.prompt: What does "假新聞" (jiǎ xīn wén) mean?
exercises.answer: Fake news

exercises.prompt: Build "Today's headline news is about education reform"
exercises.answer: 今天 的 頭條 新聞 是 關於 教育 改革

exercises.prompt: Tap the news vocab you hear
exercises.spokenText: 突 發 新 聞
options: 突 發 新 聞
頭 條 新 聞
突 然 新 聞
熱 門 新 聞
exercises.answer: 突 發 新 聞
exercises.explanation: 突發 (tū fā) — "suddenly occurring" — pairs with 新聞 to form the breaking-news idiom. Don't confuse with 頭條 (headline) or 突然 (suddenly).

exercises.prompt: Which is the most NEWS-REGISTER way to start a sentence?
options: 我朋友說今天那個事兒…
exercises.answer: 據相關媒體報道，
exercises.explanation: 據相關媒體報道 — "according to relevant media reports" — the standard news opener. The casual options would never appear in a print or anchor segment.

exercises.prompt: English speakers often drop 了 in past narration. "The earthquake happened yesterday" — which is correct?
exercises.answer: 昨天發生了地震。
exercises.explanation: Past completion of a specific event needs 了 after the verb. Dropping it sounds like a generic / habitual statement.

exercises.prompt: Resultative complement — "I read the article" (and finished it). Pick the natural form:
exercises.answer: 我看完了那篇文章。
exercises.explanation: English "I read the article" implies completion, but Chinese 看 alone just means "look at". 看完 (read-finish) explicitly marks the result.

exercises.answer: According to relevant media reports
exercises.context: jù xiāng guān méi tǐ bào dào

exercises.prompt: Build "Today's breaking news is about education reform"
exercises.answer: 今天 的 突發 新聞 是 關於 教育 改革

exercises.prompt: What does "自媒體" refer to?
exercises.answer: Influencer / self-published online media
exercises.explanation: 自媒體 — WeChat public-account / Weibo-style independent media.

exercises.prompt: "這 條 新聞 ___ 了 熱搜"
exercises.answer: 上
exercises.explanation: 上熱搜 = make it onto the trending search list. 上 here is the verb "to ascend onto".

exercises.answer: Fake news

exercises.prompt: Tap the news term you hear
exercises.answer: 記 者
exercises.explanation: 記者 (jì zhě) — reporter. 4th tone + neutral tone. Common in news bylines.

lessons.title: What happened?
lessons.description: 發生, 引起, 影響 — narrating events

exercises.prompt: What does "發生" (fā shēng) mean?
exercises.answer: To happen / occur

exercises.prompt: Build "This event has had a big impact on society"
exercises.answer: 這件 事 對 社會 有 很大 的 影響
Drew widespread attention
exercises.context: yǐn qǐ guǎng fàn guān zhù

exercises.prompt: What does "事故" (shì gù) mean?
exercises.answer: Incident / accident

exercises.prompt: the verb to its meaning
Convert active to passive: "The accident was caused by drunk driving" using 被
exercises.answer: 這 起 事故 是 由 酒駕 造成 的
exercises.explanation: News register prefers 是…由…造成的 over plain 被. 由 marks the agent. 起 is the measure word for incidents.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "This decision will have far-reaching effects":
options: 這個決定會產生深遠的影響
exercises.answer: 這個決定會產生深遠的影響
exercises.explanation: 產生影響 — "produce an impact" — is the standard collocation. 深遠 ("far-reaching") is essay-register.

exercises.source: 事件 (shì jiàn) 引發了 公眾 的 關注
exercises.answer: The incident sparked public attention
acceptableAnswers: The incident set off public attention
exercises.explanation: 引發 = trigger / set off — slightly stronger and more news-y than 引起.

exercises.prompt: Build "The incident drew widespread attention from society"
exercises.answer: 這 件 事 引起 了 社會 的 廣泛 關注

exercises.prompt: Pick the news-headline-style passive: "The suspect was arrested":
exercises.answer: 嫌疑人被警方逮捕
exercises.explanation: Headlines use formal verbs: 逮捕 (arrest) over casual 抓. 警方 over casual 警察.

exercises.answer: So far it has caused multiple injuries
acceptableAnswers: As of now, multiple people have been injured
Currently it has caused several people to be injured
exercises.context: mù qián yǐ zào chéng duō rén shòu shāng
exercises.explanation: 目前 (currently) is the news-register version of 現在. 已 (already) is its 已經 equivalent. Strip the casualness for an anchor's voice.

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb you hear
exercises.answer: 導 致
exercises.explanation: 導致 (dǎo zhì) is more clinical and explanatory; 引起 (yǐn qǐ) is more general; 造成 (zào chéng) emphasizes negative outcomes. All three appear in news but the verb you hear here is 導致.

exercises.source: 這件事引起了廣泛關注
exercises.answer: This matter drew widespread attention
acceptableAnswers: This incident has attracted widespread attention
The matter has caused broad public attention

exercises.prompt: Build "The accident caused multiple injuries"
exercises.answer: 這 起 事故 造成 了 多 人 受傷

exercises.prompt: Which verb is the most CLINICAL (cause-effect explanation)?
exercises.answer: 導致
exercises.explanation: 導致 — "lead to" — neutral and clinical. 造成 emphasizes negative outcomes; 引起 is more general.

exercises.prompt: News register: "這 個 決定 會 ___ 深遠 的 影響"
exercises.answer: 產生
exercises.explanation: 產生影響 — "produce an impact" — standard collocation in news/essay register.

exercises.answer: The suspect was arrested by the police
acceptableAnswers: The suspect has been arrested by police

exercises.prompt: Build "This event sparked public attention"
exercises.answer: 這 件 事 引發 了 公眾 的 關注

exercises.prompt: Best news-register version of "Currently, multiple people have been injured":
exercises.answer: 目前已造成多人受傷
exercises.explanation: 目前 (now, formal) + 已 (already, formal) + 造成 — three news-register markers.

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb you hear
exercises.answer: 造 成
exercises.explanation: 造成 (zào chéng) — "bring about" (often negative). 4th tone + 2nd tone.

lessons.title: Politics & society
lessons.description: 政府, 政策, 社會 — the public sphere

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
Build "The government has launched a new policy"
exercises.answer: 政府 出 臺 了 一 項 新 政策
Economic development

exercises.prompt: the public-sphere term
What does "出臺" (chū tái) mean in the context of policy?
exercises.answer: Roll out / introduce (a policy)
exercises.explanation: 出臺 here is news-register for "launch". 政府出臺新政策 = the government rolls out a new policy.

exercises.prompt: Build "This policy aims to support young people in starting businesses"
exercises.answer: 這 項 政策 旨在 支援 年輕 人 創業
exercises.explanation: 旨在 (zhǐ zài) — "aims to / is intended to" — formal news collocation. 項 is the measure word for policies.

exercises.answer: The wealth gap / gap between rich and poor

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "The new policy will affect millions of people":
options: 新政策將影響數百萬人
exercises.answer: 新政策將影響數百萬人
exercises.explanation: 將 is the news-register "will". 數百萬 = several million.

exercises.prompt: Build "The government has paid great attention to this issue"
exercises.answer: 政府 對 這 個 問題 非常 重視
exercises.explanation: 重視 — "attach importance to / take seriously". 對...重視 is the standard frame.

exercises.prompt: casual to news-register equivalent

exercises.source: 這是一個值得深思的問題
exercises.answer: This is a question worth deep reflection
acceptableAnswers: This is a topic worth pondering
This is an issue worth thinking about deeply
exercises.explanation: 深思 — "deep reflection" — common in editorials and opinion pieces.

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal connector you hear (anchor delivery)
exercises.answer: 由 於
exercises.explanation: 由於 is the news/written equivalent of 因為. 由此 ("from this") is a follow-on connector. Listen for the second syllable.

exercises.source: 政府出臺了一項新政策
exercises.answer: The government rolled out a new policy
acceptableAnswers: The government has introduced a new policy
A new policy has been launched by the government

exercises.prompt: Build "The new policy will affect millions of people"
exercises.answer: 新 政策 將 影響 數 百萬 人

exercises.prompt: Which is the formal/news-register equivalent of 因為?
exercises.answer: 由於
exercises.explanation: 由於 is the news/written cousin of 因為. Common in policy reporting.

exercises.prompt: News frame: "這 項 政策 ___ 支援 年輕 人 創業" (aims to)
exercises.answer: 旨在
exercises.explanation: 旨在 — "aims to / is intended to" — formal news collocation.

exercises.source: 政府對這個問題非常重視
exercises.answer: The government takes this issue very seriously
acceptableAnswers: The government attaches great importance to this issue
The authorities pay great attention to this issue

exercises.prompt: Build "The wealth gap is one of society's serious problems"
exercises.answer: 貧富 差距 是 社會 嚴重 問題 之一

exercises.prompt: News-register equivalent of 現在:
exercises.answer: 目前
exercises.explanation: 目前 — "currently" — formal/news register. 現在 is the casual equivalent.

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal future marker you hear
exercises.answer: 將
exercises.explanation: 將 is the formal/news-register "will". 會 is the casual equivalent.

lessons.title: Reading a headline
lessons.description: Compress meaning the way headlines do

exercises.prompt: Headlines often drop particles. "北京 今日 大雪" means:
exercises.answer: Beijing has heavy snow today
exercises.explanation: Headlines compress: no 有, no 了 — the reader fills in the verb.

exercises.prompt: Build "According to reports, the issue has been resolved"
exercises.answer: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決 了
Latest news

exercises.prompt: "專家表示" (zhuān jiā biǎo shì) means:
exercises.answer: Experts indicate / experts say

exercises.prompt: Tap the headline you hear (read aloud, news-style)
exercises.spokenText: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決 了
options: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決 了
據 報道 政府 已經 決定 了
據 調查 問題 還 沒 解決
據 媒體 報道 經濟 增長 了
exercises.answer: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決 了
exercises.explanation: Headlines are spoken in clipped, declarative cadence. Tune your ear to the opening 據報道 ("according to reports") and the verb-final 解決了 ("resolved").

exercises.prompt: Compress to a headline: "The economy is growing this year" → headline style (drop 在/了)
exercises.answer: 今年 經濟 持續 增長
exercises.explanation: Headlines drop aspect particles and choose a punchier verb (持續 = continuously). Casual full-form would be: 今年經濟在持續增長.

exercises.prompt: "暴雨襲擊北京" — pick the best translation:
exercises.answer: Rainstorm hits Beijing
exercises.explanation: 襲擊 (xí jī, "strike / attack") is favored in headline metaphors for storms, fires, and disasters.

exercises.answer: Hits a new high again
exercises.explanation: A stock collocation in finance and economics headlines: 再創新高 = the indicator/price hits another record.

exercises.prompt: the headline verb
Which is HEADLINE register, not casual?
options: 剛剛聽說啊，那個公司倒了
你聽說了嗎，那個公司不行了
exercises.answer: 知名企業宣告破產
exercises.explanation: 宣告 (declare) and 破產 (bankruptcy) are formal verbs. Headlines compress and dignify what casual speech would render with 不行了 / 倒了.

exercises.prompt: Build a headline: "Two countries sign trade agreement" (drop particles)
exercises.answer: 兩 國 簽署 貿易 協議

exercises.prompt: Tap the headline cadence you hear (anchor delivery)
exercises.spokenText: 專 家 表 示 此 事 影 響 深 遠
options: 專 家 表 示 此 事 影 響 深 遠
專 家 表 示 這 件 事 影 響 很 大
專 家 說 這 件 事 沒 什 麼 影 響
新 聞 報 道 這 件 事 的 影 響
exercises.answer: 專 家 表 示 此 事 影 響 深 遠
exercises.explanation: Listen for 此事 (this matter) instead of 這件事 — both mean the same but 此 is news/written register only. Anchors deliver these compressed forms.

exercises.source: 專家表示此事影響深遠
exercises.answer: Experts say this matter will have far-reaching effects
acceptableAnswers: Experts indicate that this incident has profound impact
Experts say the consequences of this are far-reaching

exercises.prompt: Build "According to reports, the issue has been resolved"
exercises.answer: 據 報道 問題 已經 解決

exercises.prompt: Pick the headline-register: "Two countries sign trade agreement":
options: 兩 國 簽署 貿易 協議
兩個國家簽了貿易協議了
exercises.answer: 兩 國 簽署 貿易 協議
exercises.explanation: Headlines drop particles, prefer compact forms: 兩國 (two countries), 簽署 (sign, formal), no 了.

exercises.prompt: Headline cadence: "暴雨 ___ 北京" ("Rainstorm hits Beijing")
exercises.answer: 襲擊
exercises.explanation: 襲擊 (xí jī) — "strike/attack" — headline metaphor for storms and disasters.

exercises.answer: Hits a new high again

exercises.prompt: Headline build: "This year the economy continues to grow"
exercises.answer: 今年 經濟 持續 增長

exercises.prompt: Headline-register opener:
exercises.answer: 據相關媒體報道
exercises.explanation: 據相關媒體報道 — "according to related media reports" — the standard news opener.

exercises.prompt: Tap the headline verb you hear
exercises.answer: 宣 布
exercises.explanation: 宣佈 (xuān bù) — "announce". Common in headlines: 公司宣佈.

lessons.title: Generations & society in the news
lessons.description: 80後, 北漂, 趨勢 — vocabulary for stories about people

exercises.prompt: the term

pairs.right: Young migrant chasing work in Beijing

exercises.prompt: What does "趨勢" (qū shì) mean?
exercises.answer: Trend / direction of change

exercises.prompt: Build "More and more young people choose not to get married"
exercises.answer: 越 來 越 多 的 年輕 人 選擇 不 結婚
Our generation

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "This is a very common phenomenon today":
options: 這是現在很普遍的現象
exercises.answer: 這是現在很普遍的現象

exercises.prompt: the social-trend term
Build "China is becoming an aging society"
exercises.answer: 中國 正在 成為 一 個 老齡化 社會

exercises.source: 內卷已經成為這一代人的關鍵詞
exercises.answer: Involution has become the keyword of this generation
acceptableAnswers: Involution has become a keyword for this generation
Involution is now the watchword of this generation
exercises.explanation: 內卷 — buzzword for cutthroat competition. 關鍵詞 = keyword. Common phrasing in op-eds about young Chinese.

exercises.prompt: Pick the news-style writing — "More and more young people are choosing to lie flat":
options: 越來越多的年輕人選擇躺平
現在年輕人都不幹活兒
exercises.answer: 越來越多的年輕人選擇躺平
exercises.explanation: 越來越多的 + N + 選擇 + V is the news-essay frame for trend reporting. The other options drift into casual register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Behind this trend lie complex social factors"
exercises.answer: 這 種 趨勢 背後 有 複雜 的 社會 因素
exercises.explanation: Standard editorial frame: 這種趨勢背後 + 有 + adj + 因素. 因素 (factor) over 原因 (reason) signals analytic register.

exercises.source: 我們這一代面臨著前所未有的壓力
exercises.answer: Our generation faces unprecedented pressure
acceptableAnswers: Our generation is facing pressure like never before
This generation of ours faces pressure that's never been seen before
exercises.explanation: 前所未有 (qián suǒ wèi yǒu) — "unprecedented". Stock B2 essay phrase.

exercises.prompt: Tap the slang term you hear
exercises.answer: 躺 平
exercises.explanation: 躺平 (tǎng píng, lying flat) — the opt-out meme. Listen for the falling tone on 躺 followed by rising 平.

exercises.source: 越來越多的年輕人選擇躺平
exercises.answer: More and more young people choose to lie flat
acceptableAnswers: An increasing number of young people are choosing to opt out
More young people are choosing 'lying flat'

exercises.prompt: Build "This is a very common phenomenon today"
exercises.answer: 這 是 現在 很 普遍 的 現象

exercises.prompt: What does "老齡化" mean?
exercises.answer: Population aging
exercises.explanation: 老齡化 — the aging of a society. 化 = -ization.

guide.intro: 越…越 (yuè…yuè) is one of the most useful patterns at B2 — and one of the prettiest. It means "the more X, the more Y". You'll hear it everywhere from weather reports to op-eds. This topic uses environmental issues as the playground for it.

sections.text: 越…越 — the more…the more
The pattern is fixed: 越 + verb/adjective, 越 + verb/adjective. The two halves can share a subject (which sits at the front) or have different subjects.

rows.pinyin: Tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè.
rows.translation: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

rows.pinyin: Tā yuè shuō yuè shēng qì.
rows.translation: The more he talked, the angrier he got.

rows.pinyin: Yǔ yuè xià yuè dà.
rows.translation: The rain came down heavier and heavier.

sections.text: 越來越 — getting X-er
越來越 (yuè lái yuè) is the most common form: "more and more". It always sits in front of an adjective or stative verb, and signals a trend over time.

rows.pinyin: Kōng qì yuè lái yuè chà.
rows.translation: The air is getting worse and worse.

rows.pinyin: Huán bǎo yuè lái yuè zhòng yào.
rows.translation: Environmental protection is getting more and more important.

sections.text: Don't add 很 between 越來越 and the adjective. "越來越很熱" is wrong — 越來越 already does the intensifying.
Two-subject form
When the two halves have different subjects, both subjects appear inside the pattern, after each 越:

rows.source: 天氣越冷，我越想吃火鍋。
rows.pinyin: Tiān qì yuè lěng, wǒ yuè xiǎng chī huǒ guō.
rows.translation: The colder the weather, the more I want hotpot.

topics.title: Emotions in depth
topics.description: Beyond happy and sad — frustrated, moved, embarrassed, even-if-I

guide.intro: B2 emotions need B2 grammar. The patterns 即使…也 (even if…still) and 儘管 (although) let you say things like "even if I'm tired, I'll still finish" and "although I'm sad, I'm okay" — exactly the kind of nuance you start needing once you go past 我很高興.

sections.text: 即使…也 — even if…still

即使 (jí shǐ) introduces a hypothetical or extreme condition; the second half always uses 也 (yě, "still") or 還 (hái) to mark that the result holds regardless. Without that 也, the sentence sounds incomplete to a native ear.

rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.
rows.translation: Even if it rains, I'll still go.

rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ hěn lèi, tā yě bù fàng qì.
rows.translation: Even if he's tired, he doesn't give up.

rows.pinyin: Jí shǐ méi yǒu qián, wǒ yě hěn kuài lè.
rows.translation: Even without money, I'm still happy.

sections.text: 即使 is for hypotheticals ("even if it rains") — events that may or may not happen. 即便 (jí biàn) is a slightly more formal synonym you'll see in writing.
儘管…但是 — although

儘管 (jǐn guǎn) introduces an actual fact (not a hypothetical), and 但是 (dàn shì, "but") or 還是 (hái shi, "still") marks the contrasting follow-up. Use 儘管 when the first clause is true and the second clause is the surprise.

rows.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn xià yǔ, tā hái shi qù pǎo bù le.
rows.translation: Although it was raining, he still went running.

rows.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn wǒ men hěn nǔ lì, dàn shì méi yǒu chéng gōng.

exercises.explanation: 儘管 (jǐn guǎn) and 即使 (jí shǐ) both translate as "even though/if" — but they sound very different. 儘管 starts with a 3rd-tone 盡; 即使 starts with a 2nd-tone 即. Train the ear before the grammar.

exercises.prompt: What does "難道" (nán dào) add to a question?
exercises.answer: Surprise / disbelief — "don't tell me…?"

exercises.prompt: Build "Don't tell me you don't know?"
exercises.answer: 難道 你 不 知道 嗎
How could you think that?
acceptableAnswers: How could you possibly think this way?

exercises.prompt: Tap the word you hear
exercises.answer: 反對
exercises.explanation: 反對 (fǎn duì, "oppose") and 反應 (fǎn yìng, "reaction") share 反 but the second syllable is different — 對 is 4th tone, 應 is 4th tone but with a totally different vowel. Mishearing this in a debate is a real beginner trap.

exercises.prompt: What does "難道X不Y嗎?" express?
options: A rhetorical question with disbelief — "surely X is Y?"
exercises.answer: A rhetorical question with disbelief — "surely X is Y?"
exercises.explanation: 難道 + statement + 嗎 = pushy rhetorical question. 難道你不知道嗎？ = "Don't tell me you don't know!" The expected answer is "of course I do".

exercises.prompt: Build a rhetorical question: "Don't you think this is unfair?"
exercises.answer: 難道 你 不 覺得 這 不 公平 嗎

exercises.prompt: "哪裡有這樣的道理？" (nǎ lǐ yǒu zhè yàng de dào lǐ) is a ___ question.
exercises.answer: Rhetorical (expressing protest / no way)
exercises.explanation: 哪裡 (nǎ lǐ) here is rhetorical, not asking "where". Means "how could there be such a logic?!" — a sharp pushback.

exercises.prompt: Best translation for "How could you say something like that?" (rhetorical):
exercises.answer: 你怎麼能說出這種話？
exercises.explanation: 怎麼能 — "how could (you)" — is the standard structure for outraged rhetorical questions.

exercises.prompt: Build "Why do you say it this way?"
exercises.answer: 你 為 什麼 這麼 說

exercises.prompt: the question type to its tone

exercises.answer: How could this be possible?
acceptableAnswers: There's no way this is possible
exercises.context: zhè zěn me kě néng ne
exercises.explanation: 怎麼可能 — incredulous protest. The 呢 at the end softens it from outrage to genuine bafflement.

exercises.prompt: Tap the rhetorical opener you hear
exercises.answer: 難 道
exercises.explanation: 難道 (nán dào) — "don't tell me that…". Don't confuse with 難怪 (no wonder), 難看 (ugly), or 難受 (uncomfortable). Listen for the 4th-tone 道.

exercises.prompt: 因為…所以… in English requires picking ONE ("because" or "so", not both). In Chinese, which is most natural?
options: 因為他不同意，所以我們沒決定。
因為他不同意，我們沒決定所以。
他不同意因為，我們沒決定所以。
因為他不同意。我們沒決定。
exercises.answer: 因為他不同意，所以我們沒決定。
exercises.explanation: Chinese uses 因為…所以… as a matched pair — keeping both is standard, not redundant like in English. Position: each at the start of its clause.

exercises.prompt: 把 omission — "I sent the proposal to the boss." Most natural?
exercises.answer: 我把方案發給老闆了。
exercises.explanation: When the verb has a beneficiary (發給) + a definite object (the proposal), 把 puts the object up front and keeps the directional clear. The other orders sound off or ambiguous.

exercises.answer: How could you think that?
acceptableAnswers: Why would you think this way?

exercises.answer: 難道 你 不 覺得 這 不 公平 嗎

guide.intro: Mandarin makes a sharp distinction between casual and formal register. The same idea — "Could you please send me the document?" — sounds completely different in a WeChat to a friend versus an email to a client. B2 is where you start being able to switch.

sections.text: Pronouns and politeness

您 (nín) is the polite "you". You'll use it for clients, customers, elders, professors, and strangers in any service context. In groups, 您們 is rare — most speakers stay with 您 (singular) or use 各位 (everyone).

sections.text: Casual Chinese loves 啊, 呢, 啦 — the little sentence-final particles that soften tone. Formal Chinese strips them all out. If you find yourself writing 你好啊 to a client, switch back to 您好.
Quick guide: discourse particles
Particles carry no dictionary meaning but huge emotional color. Use them in casual speech; strip them in formal writing.

items: 哎 (āi) — getting attention or expressing mild dismay: 哎，你來一下 (Hey, come here a sec)
哎呀 (āi yā) — "oh!" / "oops!" — surprise or annoyance: 哎呀，又下雨了 (Ugh, it's raining again)
啊 (a) — softens a statement or question: 你好啊 (Hi there) / 真的啊？ (Really?)
呢 (ne) — "and you?" / continuing-state marker: 你呢？ (And you?) / 他在睡覺呢 (He's sleeping [right now])
嘛 (ma) — "obviously" / "as you know": 這是常識嘛 (That's just common sense, isn't it)

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "現在很多人都在家工作" to formal register: "___ 許多 人 都 在 家 辦公"

exercises.explanation: 現在 → 目前 is the standard register lift. 許多 (instead of 很多) and 辦公 (instead of 工作) also lift the register.

exercises.prompt: the casual phrase to its formal/written equivalent

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is CASUAL?
exercises.answer: 哎，那事兒你聽說了嗎
exercises.explanation: 哎 (sentence-initial particle), 那事兒 (érhuà), 你 — every choice is informal. The others are essay/email register.

exercises.prompt: "久仰大名" (jiǔ yǎng dà míng) is used when ___
exercises.answer: Meeting someone formally for the first time — "I've long admired your name"
acceptableAnswers: Greeting someone whose reputation precedes them
Formally meeting a respected person for the first time
exercises.explanation: 久仰大名 — fixed formal greeting reserved for first introductions to someone with high standing. Don't use casually.

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal pronoun you hear
exercises.answer: 您
exercises.explanation: 您 (nín) and 你 (nǐ) sound nearly identical in fast speech, but 您 is reserved for politeness. Listen carefully — the nasal ending on 您 is slightly held.

exercises.prompt: Formal email — "I wanted to ask about the meeting yesterday." Pick the most natural Mandarin:

exercises.answer: 我想請問一下昨天會議的事。
exercises.explanation: 請問一下 softens the ask; 昨天 sits before the head noun 會議 (modifier-before-modified). English "about the meeting yesterday" reverses this — "會議昨天的事" is wrong.

敬請 回信 多謝
exercises.answer: 敬請 回覆 謝謝

Both A and B are appropriate

exercises.prompt: Tap the polite verb you hear
exercises.answer: 麻 煩

exercises.answer: 謝謝大家，我的發言到此結束
exercises.explanation: Standard speech ending: thank the audience, then close with 到此結束 ("ends here"). The casual options would never appear in a formal speech.

exercises.answer: 接 下 來 請 允 許 我 介紹

topics.description: Four-character idioms (成語) for everyday Chinese

guide.intro: Chengyu (成語, chéng yǔ) are four-character set phrases — the bite-sized literary references that pepper everyday Chinese. They're not optional flavor: native speakers reach for them in casual chat, news headlines, business emails, and parental scoldings alike. Learn 20-30 high-frequency ones at B2 and you'll start hearing them everywhere.

sections.text: What makes a chengyu different from a regular phrase?

Three things. First, the form is fixed: you can't swap words or change the order. Second, the meaning is rarely the sum of the characters — you have to know the story or convention. Third, they pack a lot into four syllables, which is why they're popular in writing.
Treat chengyu like English idioms: "spill the beans" doesn't literally mean spilling beans. The same logic applies to 畫蛇添足 ("draw a snake, add feet").
Where chengyu slot into a sentence
Most chengyu act as a predicate or adverbial — they describe an action or situation. They often sit after the subject, sometimes after 是 / 就是 to label something.

sections.text: Strategy for learning them

items: Learn the story — it'll make the meaning stick.
Memorize one example sentence per chengyu — the slot matters more than the dictionary gloss.
Don't overuse them. One chengyu per paragraph is plenty; stacking three sounds try-hard.
Listen for them in TV shows and news headlines — they're frequent in both.

sections.text: Don't translate English idioms into chengyu word-for-word. "Kill two birds with one stone" maps to 一舉兩得, not 殺兩鳥一石.

lessons.title: Pattern roundup
lessons.description: Pick the right connector

exercises.prompt: the pattern to its meaning
Pick the right connector for a real fact: "___ 下雨，他還是去跑步了"
exercises.answer: 儘管
exercises.explanation: It's a real fact (it actually rained), so 儘管 / 雖然. 即使 would be hypothetical.

exercises.prompt: Pick the right connector: "___ 下雨，我也要去" (you don't yet know if it'll rain)
exercises.answer: 即使

exercises.prompt: Pick the right connector: "他 ___ 努力工作，___ 收入很高"
exercises.answer: 不僅 / 而且
exercises.explanation: Adding two positive qualities → 不僅...而且. The other connectors don't fit "works hard AND earns well" as a parallel additive pair.

exercises.prompt: Build the connector sentence "He not only is smart, he also is hardworking" (use 不僅...而且)
exercises.answer: 他 不僅 聰明 而且 努力
exercises.explanation: 不僅 must pair with an additive (而且 / 還 / 也). It cannot pair with the contrastive 但是 — they push in opposite directions.

exercises.prompt: the connector to its required partner
"環保 ___ 來 ___ 重要" (越…越 pattern)
exercises.answer: 越 / 越
exercises.explanation: 環保越來越重要 — "environmental protection is more and more important". Both halves of the 越 frame are required.

exercises.prompt: Which is GRAMMATICALLY WRONG?
exercises.answer: 他越來越很努力
